data.raw_text:
[4:40PM] #Apongbon #EkoBridge #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic is on the high side coming in from Broad street inwards Apongbon underneath the bridge inwards the Market and ascending the Eko Bridge.

Traffic on the Marina/CMS Bridge inwards Apongbon is also on the high side.

The high volume of traffic is due to the increased number of vehicles plying this route as result of the maintenance of the expansion joints on the Ifako bridge.

Patience is key as you are assured that our Men are strategically positioned to ensure traffic is safe and seamless for us all.

data.raw_text:
Fire under control na ang sunog sa Ramos Village, Eastbank Road, Barangay Rosario, Pasig City, as of 10:45 p.m. ngayong Lunes, June 30, 2025. Umabot sa ikatlong alarma ang sunog kung saan 100 firetrucks ang rumesponde. Isa ang nahirapang huminga, ayon sa BFP. 

Patuloy ang pag-apula sa sunog habang inaalam din ang kabuuang halaga ng pinsala at bilang ng apektadong pamilya. | via @ChrisSitson

data.english_translation: Fire under control at Ramos Village, Eastbank Road, Barangy Rosario, Pasig City, as 10:45 p.m. today, June 30, 2025. The fire reaches a third alarm where 100 firetrucks retire. One has difficulty breathing, according to BFP. Fire control continues while also determining the total cost of damage and number of the affected family. Kasulatan.
